senses.gloss: (= תחר, denom. of אחר; cmp. טִיגָּן) to press, to strain the rectum.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 82a">Sabb. 82ᵃ</cite> <he>לא לִיטְחַר טפי</he> Ar. (ed. <he>ליטרח</he>; Ms. M. <he>לִיתְחַר</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) one must not strain himself too much.—V. <cite ref="I00262"><he>טְחוֹרַיָּא</he></cite>.
